family_name: Fletcher Protect / Fire Stop Party Wall Stonewool

spec.description:
Fletcher Protect Party Wall Stonewool Batts and Blankets are
non-combustible mineral wool insulation products engineered to provide passive
fire protection in party and separating wall systems between adjacent tenancies
in NCC Class 1 and Class 10 buildings. Manufactured from molten volcanic rock
(basalt) and recycled blast furnace slag, they provide exceptional resistance to
shrinkage under extreme fire temperatures up to 1000°C. They are designed to
compress-fill vertical joints, service penetrations, and top-of-wall junctions
beneath roof membranes to prevent flame and hot gas bypass.

install:
Measure the vertical cavity width or top-of-wall gap between the separating
wall and roof cladding

Select batts or blanket ensuring thickness allows a
minimum of 20% compression when installed

For vertical party wall cavities,
friction-fit 100mm x 168mm batts tightly between wall leaves

Butt consecutive
batts tightly with Vee cuts at joining ends to form continuous fire seal without
voids

For top-of-wall junctions, lay blanket along the top of party wall
framing beneath roof battens and cladding

Fasten roof sheeting down over
blanket ensuring minimum 20% compression beneath corrugations

Pack stonewool
firmly around all pipe penetrations and services crossing the party wall line

Determine linear
meterage needed along party wall lines
limitations:
Must be installed with at least 20% compression to ensure fire
seal integrity

Not designed as primary weatherproofing; must be sheltered by
roof cladding or wall linings

Protect from continuous pooling water during
construction

retrieval.rag_summary:
Fletcher Protect Party
Wall Stonewool Batts and Blankets are non-combustible rock mineral wool
insulation products engineered specifically for passive fire protection in
Class 1 multi-residential separating walls. Sized in 100mm x 168mm x 1200mm
batts and foil-faced rolls, they resist shrinkage at temperatures
exceeding 1000°C to halt fire, smoke, and hot gases from bypassing inter-tenancy
barriers. Installed under a mandatory minimum 20% compression to ensure a
void-free seal, they satisfy NCC Part 9.3 Deemed-to-Satisfy provisions for
townhouse and duplex party walls.
